topic: Data migration and calibration for company
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on migrating data for a specific company (7897) from staging to production. Initially, the request was limited to transferring two categories: Transport Hub_telt200 and Taxi Rank_telt200, along with setting calibrations (78 and 84, respectively). However, [me] suggested migrating the entire company dataset using a script for better data integrity.

After discussion, it was agreed that the full migration of the company from staging to production is necessary because all relevant modules are currently in test calculations. The participants decided on a phased approach: [p1] will recalculate the modules and then copy the results to production, followed by another recalculation.
decisions: Migrate data for company 7897 from staging to production.
The full company dataset must be migrated due to all modules being in test calculations.
action_items: [p1] will recalculate the modules and copy results to production, followed by a second recalculation.
